title: Prefer unwrap or default over eager defau...
prompt: Why is opt.unwrap_or_default() preferred over opt.unwrap_or(`String::default()`)?
answer: The method `unwrap_or_default()` evaluates the default lazily only if the `Option` is `None`. Passing `String::default()` to `unwrap_or()` eagerly constructs and allocates the default value on every invocation.
